title: Application whose agent, harness, tools, model, and context source are declared
why: §31 asks which processes depend on a model, which agents can reach production, and what happens if a tool is withdrawn. None of that is answerable while the vocabulary is registered but nothing produces it. This case pins the chain and the line between declared and inferred.

facts.note: the framework the application runs its agent on
an MCP server the harness can call, which is a path to production
the model a withdrawal would affect

absent_facts.note: the harness is LangChain; MCP is the tool protocol, not a second harness
a plain dependency is not a model
tools hang off the harness, not the application, once a harness is declared
